name: Astral-Bergschrund

civilization.name: Ysolde Dominion
civilization.notes: Long dead; only ruins and orbital debris remain of a civilization that flourished before the world turned hostile.

description: Sand owns this world, in colors from bone-white to burnt sienna, migrating with the seasons before a patient wind. Where the gusts strip it away, impact-scarred wastelands emerge like the bones of the planet.
In the calm seasons the world feels almost kind, which veterans say is exactly when it takes the careless.
Around the exotic matter deposit, reality bends in small ways. Compasses sulk, clocks gain seconds, and long-stay crews develop identical tics.
Whoever controls rare flora controls the approach lanes. Three factions have done the arithmetic, and only two of them are being subtle about it.
